Tanya Srinivasan | tanya.srinivasan113@example.com | +91 9588682257
Hyderabad, Telangana
Notice period: 90 days.

Experienced QA professional focusing on building reliable test automation and API test suites using modern frameworks and tools.

Senior QA Automation Engineer, Orbit Health — Dec 2023 - Present
Led automation for a patient-management web platform, creating pytest-based suites for regression covering critical booking and billing flows. Integrated pytest runs into CI to reduce manual test cycles, implemented flaky test handling and parameterized test cases to improve coverage. Built parallel test execution pipelines on Linux workers to cut execution time by ~40%. Developed TestNG-compatible reports for cross-team visibility and collaborated with backend teams to validate API contracts using Postman collections converted into automated checks. Used Playwright for targeted browser automation where DOM stability required it.

Test Engineer, Bluefin Logistics — May 2019 - Nov 2023
Owned functional and automation testing for shipment tracking and scheduling applications. Implemented Selenium-based UI automation integrated with TestNG for structured test suites and reporting. Designed Postman collections for API validation and automated them as part of nightly pipelines. Focused on Automation Testing to reduce regression runtime, introducing modular test libraries and reusing Selenium page objects across products. Executed cross-browser tests on Linux CI agents and adopted pytest for select service-level tests to increase reliability.

Skills: Selenium, Automation Testing, TestNG, Postman, Playwright, pytest, Linux

Education: M.Tech, Data Science, IIIT Hyderabad
